mechanism_narrative: A lower Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The Federal Funds Rate is a key monetary policy tool; lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase the present value of future cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive returns in the medium term.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% signals an economic downturn that triggers aggressive monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. High unemployment is typically followed by rate cuts, which boost equity valuations in the short term.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 9.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) and employment (PAYEMS) below 130,000 thousand signals a severe economic contraction that triggers central bank policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The interaction of weak supply and weak labor conditions creates a high probability of monetary policy intervention.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO < 100 AND PAYEMS < 130000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 220), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. High inflation erodes corporate profit margins and increases the risk of aggressive rate hikes, which depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 220, the 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts rate (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. Housing starts are a leading indicator of economic expansion, which typically leads to stronger corporate earnings and positive equity returns in the short term.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 350,000 million dollars, it signals strong economic activity that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. High residential investment is a leading indicator of sustained economic growth and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: In periods when RSAFS > 350000, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 220) combined with a low Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This combination indicates that the central bank is unable to combat inflation with rate hikes due to the low rate environment, causing equity market stress.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 220 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 (2017=100), it signals a significant economic slowdown that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. A sharp decline in industrial output typically triggers central bank policy responses that boost equity markets.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 90, the 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
